backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, stats, availability, chat, and queries for checking and listing availability with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of human‑written summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML document setting up the PWA metadata, icons, splash screens, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, start URL, theme colors, and icons.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with branding and retry link.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing precaching, offline fallback, cache cleanup, and network‑first strategies with IC traffic exclusions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up authentication gating and configures the app’s router with routes for calendar, chat, profile, admin, and more.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access denied message with a link back to the calendar for non-admin users.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Renders the login page with an II sign-in button and branding.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Displays the app logo using values from the branding config.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Provides a group chat UI with message loading, sending, pagination, and user avatars.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Shows a styled error alert with optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Contains full-page and inline loading spinners with messages.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, footer, and content area.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays navigation tabs, dynamically adding an admin tab for admin users.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides generic page wrappers with configurable max width and headers.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Renders the top bar with logo, theme switcher, PWA install controls, user menu, and logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Editable user profile card allowing name updates and profile picture upload with validation and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the user's all‑time leaderboard rank with loading skeleton support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the caller's match history with wins/losses per day and handles loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter a name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog providing platform‑specific instructions for installing the PWA to the home screen.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Shows a persistent banner when the device is offline using online/offline browser events.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper applying a faint fixed background image behind all content.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback alongside the display name in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's profile using the actor and react‑query.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Hooks for retrieving the caller's user role and admin status via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth, login flow, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA install prompting, tracking install availability, standalone mode, iOS behavior, and exposing a prompt function.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, and match history via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Stores and toggles light/dark theme, syncing it with localStorage and document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user directory data, including names and optional avatars, with fallbacks for missing profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and layout/safe-area helpers.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports branding constants like app name and logo metadata.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides utilities for converting between dates and bigint IDs, generating month grids, and formatting dates and times.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for creating or editing availability by selecting a date, time, notes, and submitting via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel showing all users and their availabilities with options to delete users or specific day availability.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Displays a monthly calendar grid highlighting days with availability and links to daily details.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Renders a standalone page containing the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a selected day and allows the caller to delete their own availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays leaderboard rankings and lets users record or remove wins and losses for selected days.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the user's profile card along with their leaderboard ranking and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utilities for converting files to byte arrays and generating initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Time utility helpers for building, formatting, and parsing 12-hour time values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, extended theme settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, issues, and feature requests related to restoring a missing Add Availability button in the calendar day view.
